description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android Wearable app. It manages permissions, connects to Google APIs, and handles user interactions to sync or delete calendar events with a wearable device.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling permission checks, Google API client connection, and interaction with the Wearable DataApi to sync or delete calendar data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, and builds the GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient if not resolving an error.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disconnects the GoogleApiClient when activity stops.

methods.name: onGetEventsClicked
methods.description: Handles user interaction to start permission check and potentially push calendar data to wearable.

methods.name: requestCalendarAndContactPermissions
methods.description: Requests calendar and contact permissions, showing rationale if needed.

methods.name: pushCalendarToWear
methods.description: Starts a service to fetch and push calendar data to the wearable device.

methods.name: onDeleteEventsClicked
methods.description: Handles user request to delete calendar data from the wearable by removing DataItems.

methods.name: deleteDataItems
methods.description: Deletes DataItems from the DataApi corresponding to calendar events.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback when the connection to GoogleApiClient is suspended.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles connection failures, attempting resolution if possible.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of resolution activities like error resolution for GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles user's response to permission requests. Initiates calendar sync if permissions granted.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends log messages to the UI log TextView.
